Operation and maintenance of the scheme as per TOR for the 5th Year. The
work includes providing sufficient technical staff, valve man, operators, Electrician and others
who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all materials chemicals
required for operation for Jack wells /WTP/pipeline repair works. Regular Maintenance of civil
structures like well approach bridge Aerator settling tank, Raw water balancing tank, S.S.F. Pure
water sump, pump house and all other civil structures. The maintanance consists of all kinds of
repairs to damaged structures cleaning and washing, and painting for civil structures once in
year. All the infrastructure must be maintained in good working condition through out the year so
as to ensure uninterrupted water supply to all the habitation through out the year and repairs and
replacement of damaged pipeline, valves etc., if found necessary it includes cost of materials
and labour charges and also monitoring of the systems. The maintenance involves raw water
raising main, gravity mains, pure water raising mains, maintaining the required discharge the
quantum of water in each pipe including controlling all the values so that each village will get
required designed quantum of water. Operation and maintenance of the water treatment plant including dosing of required quantity of Alum, Chlorine and other required necessary chemicals
established norms from time to time maintaining the quality of water as per the guide lines
CPHEEO mannual and ISI specificatons inlcuding cost of testing of water at laboratory at reguler
intrevals. Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery other mechanical
components of this scheme including electrical maintenance, covering all repairs/replacement
of electrical cable / switch board / replacement of burnt parts of machinery, all above repair and
maintenance will be carried out as per the direction of the Engineer in charge for satisfactory
functioning of the scheme to provide designed LPCD of drinking water to all the habitations of
the Project villages. (Excluding Electrical energy charges). NOTE : Helpers /watch man/ valve
man /Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at jackwell, WTP
and pure water sump points. The G.P. or VWSSC/ Concerned Section officer of the Project should
certify the stisfactorying fuctioning of the scheme and based on this payments will made to the
contractor. The contractor should maintain a log book on the working of pumping machinary at
Jackwell, WTP etc. The payment will be made by the Engineer-in-charge satisfactoryily report of
every month end. (The GP Secretary and Section officer- incharge of WSS should give
satisfactory report) Subject to conditions in Annexure-I) O&M for the year 2025-26

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Estimate for Operation & Maintenance of Multi Village Water Supply Scheme to Hebbalu & 10 Village in K.R.Nagar Taluk (For 5 Years) for the year 2026-27

itemList.description:
Operation and maintenance of the scheme as per TOR for the 5th Year. The
work includes providing sufficient technical staff, valve man, operators, Electrician and others
who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all materials chemicals
required for operation for Jack wells /WTP/pipeline repair works. Regular Maintenance of civil
structures like well approach bridge Aerator settling tank, Raw water balancing tank, S.S.F. Pure
water sump, pump house and all other civil structures. The maintanance consists of all kinds of
repairs to damaged structures cleaning and washing, and painting for civil structures once in
year. All the infrastructure must be maintained in good working condition through out the year so
as to ensure uninterrupted water supply to all the habitation through out the year and repairs and
replacement of damaged pipeline, valves etc., if found necessary it includes cost of materials
and labour charges and also monitoring of the systems. The maintenance involves raw water
raising main, gravity mains, pure water raising mains, maintaining the required discharge the
quantum of water in each pipe including controlling all the values so that each village will get
required designed quantum of water. Operation and maintenance of the water treatment plant including dosing of required quantity of Alum, Chlorine and other required necessary chemicals
established norms from time to time maintaining the quality of water as per the guide lines
CPHEEO mannual and ISI specificatons inlcuding cost of testing of water at laboratory at reguler
intrevals. Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery other mechanical
components of this scheme including electrical maintenance, covering all repairs/replacement
of electrical cable / switch board / replacement of burnt parts of machinery, all above repair and
maintenance will be carried out as per the direction of the Engineer in charge for satisfactory
functioning of the scheme to provide designed LPCD of drinking water to all the habitations of
the Project villages. (Excluding Electrical energy charges). NOTE : Helpers /watch man/ valve
man /Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at jackwell, WTP
and pure water sump points. The G.P. or VWSSC/ Concerned Section officer of the Project should
certify the stisfactorying fuctioning of the scheme and based on this payments will made to the
contractor. The contractor should maintain a log book on the working of pumping machinary at
Jackwell, WTP etc. The payment will be made by the Engineer-in-charge satisfactoryily report of
every month end. (The GP Secretary and Section officer- incharge of WSS should give
satisfactory report) Subject to conditions in Annexure-I) O&M for the year 2026-27
